% Adapted from the TeX Live pgfplotstable number-format examples.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplotstable}
\begin{document}
\pgfplotstabletypeset[
  columns={sample,plain,aligned},
  columns/sample/.style={column name=Sample,string type},
  columns/plain/.style={column name=Subscript,sci,sci zerofill,sci precision=2,sci subscript},
  columns/aligned/.style={column name=Subscript align,sci,sci zerofill,sci precision=2,sci subscript,sci sep align}
]{
sample plain aligned
A 0.001 0.001
B 0.098 0.098
C 123.4 123.4
D 1 1
E 0 0
}
\end{document}
